summary: The Indian Army, through the Department of Military Affairs, is procuring advanced training solutions including Trainee Immersive Devices with embedded training software, operational scenario content development, installation and commissioning of a high-powered station, and an instructor station. The contract includes 3 years warranty and 4 years comprehensive AMC post-warranty, focusing on simulation-based training modules. Preferences for MII and MSE suppliers are included, with clearly defined eligibility, turnover and documentation requirements. Installation, commissioning, support, and strict documentation compliance are essential.
scope_of_work: Supply, installation, commissioning, and training for 15 Trainee Immersive Devices with embedded software, development of operational scenario content and modules, installation and training of 1 high-powered station and software, and 1 high-powered instructor station with accessories. Scope includes 3-year warranty and 4-year AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract), with both online and onsite support, content development, hardware/software troubleshooting and replacement of defective parts within 72 hours.
project_type: Technology supply and service contract with installation and training components
complexity: Medium to High; owing to integration of hardware, embedded software, content development, installation at location, training, and sustained maintenance
industry_domain: Defence training, simulation and augmented/virtual reality
deliverables: 15 Trainee Immersive Devices with embedded training software
Operational scenario content and additional training modules
Installation, commissioning, and training of 1 high-powered station with software and accessories
1 High powered instructor station with software and accessories
Comprehensive training for operators and instructors
AMC service support documentation and escalation matrix
Compliance and supporting documentation as per BoQ
mandatory_documents: Certificate of local content (for MII preference)
required_certifications: Local content certification for MII compliance (with statutory/cost auditor attestation if value > Rs. 10 Crore)
eligibility_summary: Open to Class 1 and Class 2 local suppliers with minimum 50% and 20% local content respectively; MSEs and Startups are eligible for relaxations in experience and turnover criteria; OEMs and bidders must meet average annual turnover thresholds unless relaxed as specified. The bidder should not be under liquidation or bankruptcy proceedings.
experience_summary: Minimum 3 years of experience supplying similar services/products required (relaxation for MSE/Startup as per relevant policy). Must have supplied at least 10% of bid quantity in any one of the last three financial years to Central/State Govt or PSU. Supported by contract copies.
turnover_summary: Bidder: Minimum average annual turnover of INR 11 lakh over last 3 years; OEM: Minimum average annual turnover of INR 70 lakh over last 3 years. Relaxations for MSE/Startup categories upon valid supporting documents.
payment_terms: Not explicitly specified in the available tender text.
implementation_duration: 60 days from order for delivery of each item and related services
warranty: 3 years comprehensive warranty from final acceptance/installation; warranty certificates to be submitted upon delivery.
maintenance_support: 4 years comprehensive Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) post warranty, including online and onsite support, defect rectification within 72 hours, and parts replacement free of cost.
important_conditions: Option clause allows up to 50% increase or decrease in quantity at buyer's discretion.
Installation and commissioning must be by OEM/authorized personnel.
Supplied products must not be obsolete and should have minimum 7 years of residual market/shelf life.
No return of faulty storage media as per security protocol.
Escalation matrix for service support to be provided.
Comprehensive AMC to be quoted as % of product cost; payment on quarterly basis post-warranty.
Performance Bank Guarantee (PBG) of 3% of total contract value including AMC, valid through AMC period plus one year.
Compliance with all applicable Indian labour laws and codes required.
Only local suppliers (Class 1/Class 2 as per MII order) are eligible, except where specified for MSE.
Financial standing and bankruptcy declaration to be uploaded.
Non-disclosure agreement, and compliance with GeM and Defence procurement norms mandatory.
buyer_expectations: Timely delivery and installation, robust technical and training support, high reliability hardware/software, prompt aftersales service, compliance to Indian defence and procurement regulations, proper documentation, proactive engagement in issue resolution, and adherence to AMC and warranty obligations.
